note: budget is the most a number may be; measured is the worst of three rounds when last recorded (python3 tests/budgets/run.py --record). Measured on a machine shared with other builds, so a budget is a ceiling, never a target.

start_to_first_frame_ms.basis: worst of three plus a quarter
start_to_first_frame_ms.what: process start to the first GPU-complete picture, scene shell/everything, headless release build

frame_eight_panes_ms.what: p95 frame over ten chat-side flips (layout changes, gliding) with eight panes, scene shell/everything

scroll_100k_rows_ms.what: p95 frame of 195 wheel steps over a 100,000-row Assets list, after five warm-up steps

open_2000_turns_ms.basis: worst of three plus a quarter
open_2000_turns_ms.what: folding a 2,000-turn replay into the model plus the first frame of its thread

type_in_composer_ms.what: worst frame while typing 33 letters into the composer of the 2,000-turn thread

idle_commits.basis: an idle window draws nothing: zero
idle_commits.what: view commits over 600 frames of an idle chat window

idle_busy_frames.basis: an idle window draws nothing: zero
idle_busy_frames.what: frames of 600 that report work pending in an idle chat window
